newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 12.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Tuesday:
* Benchmark stock index expected to slide further, likely testing support at 9,800 points
* Index fell 0.96 percent/96.27 points to close at 9,897.27 points on Monday.
* Albert Lin, research chief, Golden Securities: "Recent bellwether electronics likely will remain weak, while other sectors such as constructions should rise to support index."
* Electronics, which plunged 5.21 percent on Monday, were not expected to have strong rebound as no strong back-up of bullish factors, Lin said.

* Government to continue auction 182 million state-owned shares of steel giant China Steel in afternoon. On Monday, it auctioned off some 92.79 million shares in China Steel at a total value of T$2.89 billion.
